name: therundown-data
title: TheRundown Data MCP
description: Official read-only MCP server for TheRundown's sports data API. Version 0.4.0 has 85 read-only tools: sportsbook odds, schedules, scores, player props and prediction-market lines from 25+ books, plus a therundown://brief resource. Run it locally over stdio with your own API key, or use the hosted server at https://mcp.therundown.io/mcp.

THERUNDOWN_API_KEY.description: Your TheRundown Product API key. The server sends it only in the X-TheRundown-Key header and never accepts it as a tool argument.
